entities.name: Treva
entities.description: One of the five Primeval Dragons of Dominaria, 'The Renewer', a white dragon of light; captured in the Fall of the Primevals and later freed.

entities.name: Fall of the Primevals
entities.description: Event in which the Primevals fell; Treva was captured by the white Numena in Argive.

entities.name: Argive
entities.description: City where Treva was crucified in the ancient library.

entities.name: Rith
entities.description: Dragon who with Rhammidarigaaz freed Treva.

entities.name: Rhammidarigaaz
entities.description: Dragon who with Rith freed Treva.

entities.name: Dromar
entities.description: Primeval last seen fleeing with Treva.

entities.name: Crosis
entities.description: Dragon defeated along with Darigaaz and Rith.

entities.name: Dragon Nations
entities.description: Dragon realms whose four dragon lords were sacrificed to free Treva.

events.summary: During the Fall of the Primevals, the white Numena captures Treva in Argive and crucifies her in the library.
events.quote: Treva was captured by the white Numena in Argive

events.summary: Millennia later Rith and Rhammidarigaaz free Treva by sacrificing four dragon lords.
events.quote: she was freed by Rith and Rhammidarigaaz through the sacrificing of four dragon lords

events.summary: Treva and Dromar flee the remains of the Dragon Nations.
events.quote: She and Dromar were last seen fleeing from the remains of the Dragon Nations
